reply: Thank you for explaining that wind insurance costing $2,300.00 was placed on your manufactured home loan through escrow, even though the bank signed off on your lack of wind coverage at the start. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send the servicer a written notice with the signed letter and your current insurance details, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for asking whether a closed or transferred mortgage account could be removed from your credit report as a goodwill gesture. We understand you want your report to reflect your current habits. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Accurate information generally remains for a set period, but if any detail is wrong, please dispute that specific item with supporting records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your streamline refinance could go ahead, and later received an email saying the loan could not be offered in your state. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. If your application was declined, you can ask the lender in writing for a notice that states the specific reason, and keep the emails you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your interest rate and closing costs changed several times before closing and that you are being charged over $2,700.00 in points. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. You do not have to sign at closing unless you are satisfied with the terms, and the lender owes you an explanation of any changes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that part of your payment was not applied, that online and phone payments were refused, and that a representative visited your home unannounced. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please keep copies of the cashier's check and money order, and send a written request asking how the funds were applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told PMI could only be removed at 70% or 75%, while your balance is now about 79.7% of the original value. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request to cancel PMI based on the original value, and keep a copy. There are specific rules on when PMI can be removed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an escrow account was added after your loan transfer, even though you had no escrow before and sent proof of insurance. We understand your frustration that emails go unanswered. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error with your insurance proof and your prior loan terms, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your employer was contacted again after you asked that it stop, and that your mortgage application was declined because remote work was misunderstood. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. You can ask in writing for the specific reason for the decision, and keep copies of your pay stubs and the emails. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that utility work is damaging your home and that you could not reach a person at your servicer after hours of trying. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send your request for guidance in writing to the servicer's address on your statement, and keep photos and records of the damage. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your mortgage payments keep being reversed because of a special character in your name, causing late fees. We understand how frustrating this has been for months. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send a written notice of error with your bank's report showing the cause, and ask for the late fees to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing the difficult period you have been through and your plan to return to your home with your family. We understand how important this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team, including your request to extend the forbearance. Please send the request in writing before the current end date, and ask what repayment options will follow. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that foreclosure is continuing in court while you are making payments under an agreement you believe is unfair. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please keep proof of each payment and respond to every court deadline. A HUD-approved housing counselor can help you review your options for free. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that force-placed insurance was added to your escrow even though your own policy was active, and that you have sent a notice of error. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please keep your policy declarations, the recorded calls and a copy of your notice of error, and ask your insurer to send proof of coverage directly. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your loan was sold, insurance costs were added that raised your monthly payment sharply, and that you are told you are a payment behind. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error asking for an escrow breakdown and payment history, and keep your payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your payment rose because of an escrow error, that the loan transfer prevented you from paying, and that a late payment was then reported. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written notice of error with your tax records and transfer letters, and keep proof of your payment attempts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for raising your concern that you are asked to send sensitive mortgage assistance documents by unencrypted email. We understand why this worries you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team, including secure ways to submit documents. Please ask in writing for a secure upload option or a mailing address, and avoid sending full account numbers by email. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining the difficulties you have had since your loan was transferred, and that higher HOA fees and taxes have made your payments hard to manage. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please ask in writing about the assistance options available, and be cautious of anyone who asks for fees upfront to help with a modification. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a typo in your last name has kept your account locked for years despite sending your identification. We understand your frustration after so many calls and letters. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please send a written request to correct your name, with copies of your ID, and ask for written confirmation once it is fixed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your notice of error asking for your escrow to be adjusted now that you have a full property tax exemption. We understand why you want your payment recalculated. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please keep a copy of the exemption letter and proof of when your notice was received, and ask for a new escrow analysis. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have had no updates on your refinance application or your reconsideration of value request, despite several messages. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please send a written request for the status of your application and the value review, and keep copies of your messages and uploads. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after declining a HELOC offer, you received a call that criticized other lenders and gave you information you believe was incorrect. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team, including how the call was handled. Lenders must give you clear information about HELOC terms and costs, so keep any written terms you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a 120-day delinquency was reported while your complete loss mitigation package was still under review. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team, including the credit reporting. Please keep the acknowledgment of your complete package, and dispute the entry with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your foreclosure sale is close, that payments have been returned, and that assistance program documents keep being reported as not received. We understand the urgency. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the loss mitigation team. Please send a written request for a reinstatement quote and confirmation that the program documents were received, and keep all proof. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a written request for proof of ownership of your loan and believe the response was incomplete. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please keep a copy of your request and the response, and send a follow-up written request for information to the servicer's designated address. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your lender has missed three closing dates and that your cash to close and loan costs have risen sharply. We understand the risk to your purchase. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please compare each Closing Disclosure with your Loan Estimate, and make sure you receive the final one at least three business days before closing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your new servicer says you missed a payment, even though you have records from the trustee and your direct payments. We understand your frustration after two years. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written notice of error with the trustee's records and your payment proof, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have been waiting since last year for an equity payment check to be reissued and have been given different reasons. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request asking for the date, amount and mailing address of any check issued, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cannot log in after your loan transferred and have received only automated replies, with an insurance payment due soon. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please keep your transfer notice and the insurance invoice, and send the invoice by mail as well. A short grace period applies after a servicing transfer. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have spent 22 months trying to correct your mortgage balance and modify the loan, and that foreclosure has started without notice. We understand how serious this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please send a written notice of error about the balance and keep copies. Your servicer generally must contact you about options to avoid foreclosure. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that flood insurance was forced on your mortgage after transfer, even though your home is not in a flood zone, and that your proof has not been acted on. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice with the flood zone determination and risk assessments, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
